name: Tsukiusa: la historia de la luna, el espejo y un conejito blanco
source:
A kid, having lost his desire to live after a purposeless life, lies on a hospital bed with a terminal illness. One night, when he was about to abandon it all for good, he casts his wish upon the moon.
A mysterious girl answers her calling, she has climbed up his window some how to talk to him. But the deal she’s about to offer, a second chance, comes under conditions that he may not fully comprehend.
An intimate story, riddled with references, about letting time go by. Don’t read this story looking for a concrete plot with a beginning and an end; some questions don’t have straight answers.

[Translated from the publication on [url=https://no-olvidar.com/ni/tsukiusa]no-olvidar[/url]]
translation:
一个孩子在经历了漫无目的的生活后失去了生存的欲望，身患绝症躺在医院的病床上。一天晚上，当他准备永远放弃这一切时，他向月亮许下了自己的愿望。
一个神秘的女孩响应了她的召唤，她爬上他的窗户与他交谈。但她即将提供的交易，即第二次机会，是在他可能无法完全理解的条件下进行的。
这是一个关于让时间流逝的私密故事，充满了参考资料。阅读这个故事时，不要寻找有开头和结尾的具体情节；有些问题没有直接答案。
